import boto3, json, os, time
sqs = boto3.client("sqs")
def handler(event, context):
    audit = {"kind": "runtime_attempt", "label": event["label"], "event": event,
             "runtime_request_id": context.aws_request_id,
             "invoked_function_arn": context.invoked_function_arn,
             "function_version": context.function_version,
             "log_stream_name": context.log_stream_name,
             "runtime_time_ms": int(time.time() * 1000)}
    sqs.send_message(QueueUrl=os.environ["AUDIT_QUEUE_URL"], MessageBody=json.dumps(audit))
    raise ValueError("controlled-expiry-failure:" + event["label"])

import boto3, json, os, time
sqs = boto3.client("sqs")
def handler(event, context):
    audit = {"kind": "runtime_attempt", "label": event["label"], "event": event,
             "runtime_request_id": context.aws_request_id,
             "invoked_function_arn": context.invoked_function_arn,
             "function_version": context.function_version,
             "log_stream_name": context.log_stream_name,
             "runtime_time_ms": int(time.time() * 1000)}
    sqs.send_message(QueueUrl=os.environ["AUDIT_QUEUE_URL"], MessageBody=json.dumps(audit))
    if event['label'] == 'hold':
        time.sleep(110)
        return {'held': True}
    raise ValueError('unexpected-execution:' + event['label'])
